question: Which of the following is NOT among the commercial sources of energy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fuel wood**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Fuel wood** is primarily considered a **non-commercial** source of energy
 
• It is because it is often gathered locally by households for personal use, especially in rural areas.
